method: Immutable versioned hypothesis registry; observations never automatically become model filters; prior results are not prospective validation.

entries.title: Role expansion versus temporary outlier
entries.question: Are Under bets less reliable when pregame role/usage rose >10 points?
entries.notes: T12 vs T13 locked graded wagers; correlated bets; 2026 week 8 generated hypothesis.
entries.decision: No promotion or threshold changes without preregistered prospective validation

entries.title: Big recent outlier regression

entries.notes: Do not infer causality from the postgame pattern.
entries.decision: No promotion or threshold changes without preregistered prospective validation

entries.title: Role growth and statistical spike jointly

entries.notes: Prospective weeks 9+ required to validate Week 8 discovery.
entries.decision: No promotion or threshold changes without preregistered prospective validation

entries.title: Participation-disrupted result sensitivity

entries.notes: Postgame diagnostic only; event cause unverified and cannot be used as a prospective filter.
entries.decision: No promotion or threshold changes without preregistered prospective validation

entries.title: Individual player temperature-band O/U records
entries.question: Do individual player/market Over and Under records and price-based ROI differ across fixed game-temperature bands, and do those differences persist prospectively?
entries.notes: 2025 and completed 2026 research: fixed <32, 32–49, 50–69, 70–84, 85+ F bands; game-specific roof status; reported temperature then historical archive fallback; indoor/closed separate. 12,043 distinct graded props. Historical discovery only; multiple-comparison and confounding risks. Full queryable dataset saved with analysis deliverable.
entries.decision: No frozen-model changes; preregister a future sample before using discovered player/weather records as predictive filters.
